# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_3DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE to 3 days (weekly) for the same ITM-2 signal used in 0DTE will capture additional theta decay benefits while maintaining the same directional edge, as evidenced by the monotonic increase in OOS exp/tr from 0DTE to 2DTE. We expect 3DTE to further improve the edge without increasing losing trades on J anchor days.

## Mechanism

Use the same directional signal (e.g., VWAP continuation or BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON) but enter at the ITM-2 strike with 3 days to exit (weekly option) instead of 0DTE. Exit at -8%/+30% of the entry premium, same as the 0DTE and 2DTE variants. The signal generation and exit logic remain unchanged; only the DTE is increased to 3.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on ITM-2 3DTE premium ~$3.50, 28 contracts = $9,800 risk, 50% of $20K account)
2. **Sample bias:** Using 16 months of SPY 5m data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for Stage-1 backtest. Selection method: all days where the signal fires. Overfit risk: mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on J anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (to be run after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (to be run after OOS)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: adverse gap against position on expiration week; max drawdown: could exceed 50% if held through adverse news; blow-up scenario: holding through expiration week with adverse move and assignment risk.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
